$comment: Curated list. Edited by hand for now; the Google Sheet sync will generate this file later. Episode picks match on a case-insensitive piece of the episode title (or an exact guid). Run `npm run snapshot` after editing.

shows.title: Mystery Show
shows.blurb: Starlee Kine solves small mysteries that can't be solved by going online, and in the process turns strangers into friends. One season, six cases, no misses.

picks.title: Belt Buckle
picks.note: A mysterious belt buckle. The Atlantic's #1 podcast episode of 2015.

picks.title: Britney
picks.note: Case #2. A small pop-culture mystery that gets surprisingly moving.

picks.title: Video Store
picks.note: Case #1. A neighborhood video store vanishes. The case that started it all.

shows.title: Reply All
shows.blurb: A show about the internet that was really about people. Tech support mysteries, scams, and the strange corners of being online.

picks.title: Long Distance
picks.note: A scam call turns into a trip across the world. Two parts; start here.

picks.title: The Case of the Missing Hit
picks.note: A man can't stop hearing a song nobody else remembers.

picks.title: The Snapchat Thief
picks.note: Someone stole a friend's Snapchat account. Tracking them down goes further than expected.

picks.title: Boy in Photo
picks.note: A strange old photo, and a search for the people in it.

shows.title: S-Town
shows.blurb: An email about a murder in a small Alabama town becomes a portrait of one extraordinary, difficult man. Seven chapters, best heard in order.

picks.title: Chapter I
picks.note: Start at the beginning. This one only works in order.

picks.title: Chapter II
picks.note: The story turns somewhere nobody saw coming.

shows.title: Surprisingly Awesome
shows.blurb: Each episode takes something boring — mold, concrete, broccoli — and argues that it's secretly fascinating. It usually wins.

picks.title: Mold
picks.note: The pilot. You will think about mold differently.

picks.title: Free Throws
picks.note: Why don't basketball players shoot underhanded, if it works better?

picks.title: Concrete
picks.note: The most used material on earth, and why it matters.

shows.title: Invisibilia
shows.hosts: Lulu Miller, Alix Spiegel, Hanna Rosin
shows.blurb: Stories about the invisible forces that shape human behavior: thoughts, emotions, expectations. Cancelled by NPR in 2023.

picks.title: The Secret History of Thoughts
picks.note: What if your darkest thoughts don't mean anything at all?

picks.title: How to Become Batman
picks.note: A blind man who sees with echoes, and the power of expectations.

picks.title: Fearless
picks.note: A woman who can't feel fear, and what fear does for the rest of us.

shows.title: Crimetown
shows.blurb: Season one is the story of Providence, Rhode Island: the mob, the mayor, and the city that couldn't tell them apart.

picks.title: Divine Providence
picks.note: Meet Providence, and Buddy Cianci.

picks.title: The Trial of Buddy Cianci
picks.note: How the mayor's story ends.

shows.title: Wind of Change
shows.blurb: Did the CIA write the Scorpions' power ballad "Wind of Change"? A journalist chases a rumor about rock music and the end of the Cold War.

picks.title: My Friend Michael
picks.note: The rumor, and where it came from.

shows.title: Dolly Parton's America
shows.blurb: Why does everyone love Dolly Parton? A nine-part look at Dolly, her songs, and the divided country that agrees on her.

picks.title: Jolene
picks.note: What "Jolene" is really about.

picks.title: Sad Ass Songs
picks.note: Dolly's darkest songs and where they came from.

shows.title: Limetown
shows.blurb: A fictional public radio reporter investigates the night 300 people vanished from a research town in Tennessee. Audio drama that sounds uncomfortably real.

picks.title: What We Know
picks.note: Episode one. Hard to stop after this.

shows.title: Alice Isn't Dead
shows.blurb: A truck driver crosses America searching for her wife, who was supposed to be dead. A road-trip horror story told over CB radio.

picks.title: Omelet
picks.note: Part one, chapter one.

shows.title: Longform
shows.hosts: Aaron Lammer, Max Linsky, Evan Ratliff
shows.blurb: Twelve years of long conversations with nonfiction writers about how they work.

picks.title: David Grann
picks.note: How one of the best investigative writers finds stories.

shows.title: The History of Rome
shows.blurb: The whole history of the Roman Empire, from founding myth to fall, one episode at a time. The show that started a genre.

picks.title: In the Beginning
picks.note: Episode one. Settle in.

picks.title: The Seven Kings of Rome
picks.note: The legendary kings, before the Republic.
